posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Donner:

A scrapper is someone who gets into fights.  So, I can totally see why people still call Sky-Scraper Sky-Scrapper.  She's feisty and gets into fights a lot. 

Yeah, but a skyscraper is already a thing. It's a play on the fact that she can become really really tall, like those giant buildings.

Skyscrapper isn't even an existing word. If she was Sky-Scrapper, that would mean someone who fights in the sky, and as far as I can tell she isn't particularly sky-based.

Basically Sky-Scraper is an interesting superhero name that makes sense and is an allusion to a familiar object. Sky-Scrapper is a crap name, superhero or otherwise.
